```{r}
#| label: tbl-rd04-fuel-estimates
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "Fuel load estimates by retention treatment and measurement phase. Entries are mean (lower, upper 95% confidence limits), in Mg ha^-1^. GS = group selection; LD = low-density dispersed retention; HA = high-density aggregated retention; HD = high-density dispersed retention. Load means include modeled zeros, integrate over all fitted random intercepts, and equally weight the four study-site contexts. Woody reduction is pre-PCT minus post-PCT from the joint matched phase model, retaining pre/post covariance; it represents a potential surface-fuel contribution, not measured slash. Load intervals use the log-scale delta method; reduction intervals use the response-scale delta method. Intervals describe means, not individual observations, and exclude model-selection and component-derivation uncertainty. Models remain provisional. Post-PCT litter and duff are not estimated."

# tbl-rd04-fuel-estimates
fuel_table <- read.csv("outputs/fuel/tables/rd04-fuel-display.csv", check.names = FALSE)
readRDS("outputs/helpers/task-helpers.rds")$publication_table(fuel_table)
```
